subject: MedAxis private plan — negotiated procurement schedule & SLA addendum
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@medaxis.com>
To: lukas_meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@medaxis.com; Daniel Park <daniel.park@medaxis.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Private plan inquiry + procurement timeline

Hi Lukas —

Thanks for the intro last week. MedAxis is ready to move forward on an Azure Private Plan for our inference workload (pilot -> prod). Procurement asked me to capture:

- Committed monthly spend levels and the monthly billing cadence you can support.
- Whether Redwood can accept a PO before final DocuSign execution (we sometimes need to start onboarding while legal finalizes).
- SLA credit language and whether Redwood will accept a 99.9% uptime target with service credits commensurate with our enterprise contract.
- Any onboarding/additional SOWs required from your side for a dedicated migration window.

We are aiming to have a signed agreement and first invoice issued by 2/12 so Ops can schedule the infra window in late Feb. Can you confirm timeline and attach the standard private plan commercial + SLA addendum?

Best,
Asha Rao
Director, Strategic Procurement
MedAxis Health

Attachment: (none)
From: lukas_meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@medaxis.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private plan inquiry + procurement timeline

Hi Asha —

Great to hear — and thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers up front:

- Committed spend: we can structure a three-tier private plan (Pilot, Baseline, Peak) with committed monthly USD amounts. I attached a high-level pricing summary for the SKU you trialed last month.
- PO before DocuSign: yes, we can accept a PO to trigger onboarding (we require PO number + acknowledgement of commercial terms); signature should follow within the 7–10 business day window.
- SLA: Redwood will support a 99.9% monthly availability SLO for the Dedicated Private plan. Our standard SLA addendum specifies service credit tiers; legal is open to negotiation on percent thresholds for enterprise accounts.
- Onboarding: we include a 5-business-day assisted onboarding package for Private plans; larger migrations can be scoped as an SOW.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share our standard commercial term sheet + SLA addendum for your procurement/legal review (attached: RDW_SLA_Addendum_v1.docx).
2) If the PO route works, send me the PO PDF and I’ll route to Finance for invoice setup.
3) Marissa (cc’d) is our commercial contracts lead and will pick up any redlines.

We can meet briefly today at 2pm PT if that helps accelerate — otherwise I’ll follow up with the documents.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing-summary-privatesku.csv, RDW_SLA_Addendum_v1.docx
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@medaxis.com>
Cc: lukas_meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private plan inquiry + procurement timeline

Hi Asha —

Thanks for the patience. I reviewed RDW_SLA_Addendum_v1 and noted three contract items MedAxis may want tailored:

1) Payment terms: our default is Net 30. If MedAxis requires Net 45, we can accommodate for the initial year with an invoice acceptance confirmation.
2) PO acceptance: we typically require a countersignature within 30 days after PO receipt. For expedited onboarding we can accept a PO as an interim trigger but will add language that final signature is required within 10 business days of the PO effective date.
3) Service credit caps: our template caps credits at 20% of monthly fees. If MedAxis requests higher caps for enterprise compliance we are willing to discuss incremental increases tied to committed spend bands.

Markup summary attached (redlines). Key asks from you: confirm preferred payment term, provide a sample PO PDF (so Finance can add remittance details), and confirm whether the onboarding SOW should include a separate milestone for KV-cache migration support.

If you want, Lauren can run a short commercial exception review with Finance to approve the Net 45 and any billing routing.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RDW_SLA_Addendum_v1-markup.docx
From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@medaxis.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, lukas_meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medaxis.com>, procurement@medaxis.com
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private plan inquiry + procurement timeline

Marissa / Lukas —

Thanks for the quick review and the redlines. Answers below:

- Payment: Net 45 is preferable for MedAxis. We can sign an acceptance confirmation to expedite.
- PO: attaching our PO (MedAxis_PO_98721.pdf). Please confirm this is sufficient to start onboarding and for Finance to set up invoicing.
- Service credits: we can accept the 20% cap conditional on moving to a 0.5% additional credit band if uptime falls below 99.5% for two consecutive months. If you can agree to that we’ll finalize the DocuSign today.
- Onboarding SOW: yes — please include KV-cache migration assistance as Milestone 2. We expect the migration to be scheduled the week of 3/2.

Asha

Hi Asha —

Appreciate the PO and clarity. Finance confirmed they can provision an invoice against MedAxis_PO_98721 to begin the onboarding flow. Two items we captured before DocuSign:

- We will update the SLA addendum to add the conditional additional credit band (0.5% extra if uptime <99.5% for two consecutive months) limited to the committed spend bucket you select.
- We will set the payment term to Net 45 for year one and include an invoice acceptance confirmation clause.

I’ve routed the updated addendum to DocuSign and sent the HubSpot deal (link below). Once DocuSign is signed we’ll queue the onboarding team and schedule the KV-cache migration milestone for the week of 3/2 per Asha’s request.
